crossRefs.note: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As Yahweh…
Though men may rise up to pursue you, and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of…
Then she said, “Please let the king remember Yahweh your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they…
but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
Therefore I beg you to take some food; for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

translations.web: And not a hair of your head will perish.
translations.bsb: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
translations.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
translations.asv: And not a hair of your head shall perish.
